title: sre-weekly-update-2026-05-23
content:
SRE Weekly Update — 2026-05-23
Owner: Maya Thompson
Team: eng-sre
Status: final

Highlights:
- Minimal customer impact this week overall. Key focus on autoscale stability and SLO monitoring improvements.
- Rolled out improved autoscale cooldown config to dedicated pools (canary -> global). Initial telemetry looks promising.
- Completed first pass of runbook updates for model-cache eviction and prefix cache warmup.

Incidents (last 7 days):
1) 2026-05-19 08:12 UTC — Dedicated routing degradation (P1 -> mitigated)
   - Summary: A mis-tuned autoscaler cooldown combined with a spike from a benchmarking job caused repeated scale-downs during burst traffic, resulting in queued requests and elevated request latencies for ~22 minutes. Affected customers: small fraction of Dedicated customers in us-west-2.
   - Impact: Increased p95 latency from 120ms -> 1.2s, ~0.8% error-rate spike due to timeouts. No data loss.
   - Root cause (prelim): autoscale cooldown incorrectly copied from default policy; did not respect ongoing allocation adjustments for dedicated pools.
   - Mitigation: reverted cooldown to previous stable policy at 08:34 UTC; manual buffer instances added to pool for ~30 minutes.
   - Follow-up: full postmortem in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-34567). Action owner: Jordan Lee (JIRA-INFRA-4231).

SLO / Monitoring Update:
- Availability SLO (hosted API): 99.95% monthly target. Current month-to-date: 99.98% (on track).
- Dedicated routing latency SLO: p95 <= 250ms. This week p95 (global) = 210ms; us-west-2 saw spike to 1.2s during incident but recovered.
- Alerting: adjusted dedicated-pool-scale anomalies alert to trigger earlier on repeated small-scale events (alert tuning ticket: JIRA-SRE-789).
- Datadog dashboards: added a panel for sustained queue-length per pool.

On-call Handoffs / Rota:
- Week (2026-05-16 -> 2026-05-23): Primary: Priya Desai; Secondary: Liam O'Connor.
- Current week (2026-05-23 -> 2026-05-30): Primary: Sofia Alvarez; Secondary: Jordan Lee.
- Handoff notes: Priya -> Sofia (05-23 09:00 UTC) — documented in handoff thread (Slack link above). Items carried over: follow-up on autoscale postmortem, validate canary metrics for new cooldown settings, finalize runbook edits for cache-evict.

Runbooks / Playbooks:
- Updated: model-cache-eviction-playbook.md — added steps to rehydrate prefix cache and diagnostic checks. Reviewer: Liam O'Connor.
- TODO: add exact commands to safely add buffer instances to dedicated pools (owner: Jordan Lee).

Action Items (open):
- INFRA-4231: Fix autoscale policy templating to ensure pool-specific cooldowns are preserved. Owner: Jordan Lee. ETA: 2026-05-28.
- SRE-789: Alert tuning for scale-flapping detection. Owner: Priya Desai. ETA: 2026-05-26.
- Runbook: Add buffer instance playbook steps + verification checklist. Owner: Liam O'Connor. ETA: 2026-05-25.
- Load test: schedule a controlled spike test to validate new cooldown config across dedicated pools. Owner: Sofia Alvarez. ETA: 2026-06-02.

Upcoming Work / Notes:
- Next week: focused work on cache warmup strategies for heavy prompt prefixes (goal: reduce cold-start p95 by ~20%).
- SLO review scheduled with product on 2026-05-27 to confirm tolerance for occasional dedicated pool transient spikes during large customer bursts.
- Investigate adding a short-lived "spring buffer" feature to temporarily increase minimum instances during known large batch jobs (research spike planned).

Operational Metrics Snapshot (week ending 2026-05-23):
- Mean request latency (global): 86ms
- p95 request latency (global): 210ms
- Error rate (5xx): 0.12% (baseline ~0.05%) — spike attributable to 2026-05-19 event
- Avg queue length (dedicated pools): 0.7 (peak 6.4 during incident)

Notes / Loose Ends:
- Need to follow up with Solutions Eng to ask customers to avoid large benchmark jobs hitting production dedicated pools without prior coordination. (Action: Maya to draft guidance)
- Confirm whether KMS rotation scheduled next month impacts on-call process (security calendar conflict check).

If you need more detail on the incident timeline or want the postmortem link, ping Jordan or check CONFLUENCE-34567.

End of update.
